item_title: Replay Buffers Beat Summaries for Long-Running Coding Agents
hook: Most agent harnesses forget by summarising. The evidence says that is the expensive way.
body:
Replaying tool results, and dropping the ones that stop mattering, cut tokens per task by 41% on 40 coding tasks and retries by 31%.

Every task is Python and the benchmark is small, so this is a good reason to test the idea, not to adopt it.
pov: My own harness replays the last twelve tool results. I would test this on our 300-step traces.
